purpose: Premarket price action may provide a directional prior, but this strategy does not use PDH/PDL/PWH/PWL or prior-close/gap reference levels. The prior is built only from causal premarket net movement, candle control and higher/lower structure and is never a standalone signal.

counter_plan_strong_5m_breakout: ALLOW_ONLY_IF_MAJOR_ALLOWED_LOCATION; the shared kernel separately requires the frozen 5m breakout/extension/force equation
